author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Scalar creation and annihilation weights preserve the existing h=1 two-order identity at all shifts exactly when their products are c k; in characteristic zero, nonzero c forces all indices and zero c makes the standard positive-grade vacuum pairing degenerate. Any infinitely supported scalar sequence with a eventually nondegenerate order-d recurrence with coefficients varying by index has support lower density at least 1/d, over any field; this is sharp. A characteristic-p example has nonzero c, missing annihilation modes, and degenerate standard vacuum pairing despite satisfying h=1. Uniformly over all primes p, its vacuum-pairing quotient has exp(Theta(sqrt(E))) individual-grade and cumulative grade dimensions.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the written argument
